scope: Current shipping snapshot write/path/protection calls and exact A37/APP04 observations, contrasted with H02 host-origin result. Not a repeat broad audit, own-template source review or application qualification.
shipping_path: iOS concrete implementation is in composeApp, bound by PlatformStorage.ios.kt to shared/storage SnapshotFileSystem. FileBackedSnapshotStore awaits write(sessionId.raw + .snapshot.json) before reporting save success.

IosSnapshotFileSystem resolves Application Support/Parlor/snapshots; directory creation requests NSFileProtectionKey=NSFileProtectionComplete. filePath uses that directory plus the same validated name. writeProtected uses NSDataWritingAtomic OR NSDataWritingFileProtectionComplete, rejects false, then performs backup exclusion with a fresh-URL readback.

No shipping explicit post-write protection setter or Complete readback exists. The backup setter changes NSURLIsExcludedFromBackupKey, not protection. Keychain AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly describes the distinct encryption-key item; it does not set the snapshot file class.

source_applicability.directly_matched: Both manifests retain original/copied hashes equal to current IosSnapshotFileSystem c2852faf and FileBackedSnapshotStore e2ca0be2. This establishes those source inputs, not current full-application execution.

a37.limit: These26 are FileManager comparisons, not26 same-inode kernel-class readings. A37 does not retain FD/stat bracketing for each original comparison; do not retroactively label every A37 inode class3 or claim hardware enforcement.

The actual IosSnapshotFileSystem backupExcluder seam observes after completed directory creation/write, immediately before and after the real production backup operation. Kotlin stat before/after, native same-inode callback and all five native read brackets agree; descriptors close before overwrite.

pd08_contrast.reused_observation: Previously independently inspected native Objective-C Complete|Atomic, None|Atomic, Atomic-only and Complete-without-Atomic requests all succeeded while FM remained missing and regular-file URL/kernel values remained until-first-authentication/class3. Real replacement and successful NSURL Complete setter did not improve them; direct kernel setter was unavailable.

h02.scope: HOST_ORIGIN_ONLY; freshly host-created default file, not a None request, simulator fixture or production snapshot.
h02.actual: Native macOS15.7.9 NSFileManager setAttributes Complete returned false with Cocoa error256. Same owned40-byte inode3535393 before/after: FM and NSURL until-first-authentication, fcntl/returned-mask attrlist class3, APFS content-protection capability unsupported. Both metadata collections valid and descriptors closed.
h02.meaning: H02 is not a working Complete setter control. Class3 is also present without shipping Kotlin, atomic replacement or backup operations. False/Cocoa256 is not evidence of a suppressed ENOTSUP or any particular underlying errno/callee; that information was not retained. Different API/runtime/origin prevents assigning the host error to the shipping NSData/createDirectory path.

causal_findings.candidate: Wrong final path, stale replacement inode, wrong protection key/mask, backup-only or Kotlin-reader-only cause
causal_findings.finding: No such actionable source defect identified. Source/path mapping and APP04 same-inode results directly constrain these explanations; PD08 also reproduces the anomaly without Kotlin or Atomic.

Creation attributes apply to new directories; shipping does not explicitly re-set/verify an existing directory. This is an existing-directory coverage gap, not the cause of all observed failures: APP04 proves failure on an initially absent directory and fresh files.

Concrete acceptance gap: source reports completed writes after BOOL success and backup verification without checking Complete; A37/APP04 demonstrate functional success alongside protection failure. Verification could expose/reject that state, but is not a demonstrated way to obtain Complete or repair class3. No production change is proposed as a proven fix.

causal_findings.candidate: Add post-write host-style setter or remove Atomic
causal_findings.finding: No evidence-supported fix: H02 setter failed; PD08 non-atomic and NSURL contrasts did not improve metadata. Do not weaken the original getter equality, remove atomicity, change Keychain policy or treat class3/unsupported as Complete.

conclusion: The observed final-file checks are meaningful failures of the stated FileManager Complete requirement, not proven wrong-file measurements. No uniquely shipping creation/replace/key-setting defect explains the complete evidence set. The required protection postcondition remains unmet/unverified; native controls are not proof that the application is correct. Keep A37 0/26, APP04 0/6 and PD08 0/5 separate; H02 adds no strict/application PASS.
operations: Read-only scoped source/raw JSON and hash/count comparisons; no project imports, tests, builds, API/network, process-control or shipping/diagnostic edits. Only this review JSON is authored; existing execution/custody reviews are reused without promoting them.
